body.name: Generated-center replicated local-polynomial estimator
body.construction: Split \((Z_j)_{j=1}^{N}\) into \(K_D\) folds. For fold \(k\), project the complementary donor mean onto \(([0,1]^d)^S\) and denote cohort \(s\)'s block by \(\widetilde z_{sk}\). Select \(h_{sk}\) as the first bandwidth on a finite dyadic grid above \(h_s\) whose historical polynomial Gram matrix has minimum eigenvalue at least a fixed fraction of \(c_X\). On a successful fit set \(u_{stk}=(X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk})/h_{sk}\), \(w_{stk}=K(u_{stk})\), and let \(\widehat\gamma_{sk}\) minimize \(\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}[Q_{sti}-b_r(u_{stk})^{\top}\gamma]^2\). Define the raw fold-averaged fit \(\widehat m_s=K_D^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}e_0^{\top}\widehat\gamma_{sk}\) and \(\widehat\tau=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s(\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}-\widehat m_s)\). On a failed selected fit set its intercept contribution to zero. Estimate \(\Sigma\) by the spectrally clipped full sample covariance \(\widehat\Sigma\); no clipping is applied to a successful fitted intercept or to \(\widehat\tau\).
